title: GE Vernova Q2 2026 earnings release
excerpt: Q2 orders were USD 24.2 billion, backlog was USD 176 billion, and free cash flow was USD 5.1 billion; 2026 free-cash-flow guidance rose to USD 11.5-12.5 billion.
summary: The byte-identical SEC-filed Q2 release remains the latest earnings evidence and confirms strong Power and Electrification demand, margin expansion, cash generation and raised guidance.
